response.original_title: How do I add a room to my Princess Cruise?
response.overview: [Room Addition] How do I add a room to my Princess Cruise?  You cannot add a separate room to an existing Princess Cruises booking directly through your online account or mobile app. How to Add a Room Call Customer Service: Contact Princess Cruises customer support at +1-866-259-1002 (US). Support hours are Monday–Friday from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM, and weekends from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM (Eastern time). Contact Your Travel Agent: +1-866-259-1002 (US) If you booked your cruise through a travel advisor or agency, you must contact them directly to handle the new booking +1-866-259-1002 (US).
